gpu_tip: ~40GB total at 128K context. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 5060) plus ~48GB of DDR5 system RAM covers the whole model — llama.cpp keeps as many layers on the GPU as fit and runs the rest from RAM.
mac_tip: Needs ~40GB — fits a 64GB MacBook Pro (M4 Pro/Max or M5 Pro/Max) comfortably; a 48GB config is tight.
